golden_why: #43: a gone worker's tree held one committed, unpushed commit and no File ownership row named it; the audit printed trees=0 and the coordinator found the work only by hand.
description: A new session picks up a day that already has files. One worker, impl-7, is registered against `wt-retry` and its process is gone. Its tree holds a commit that exists only there: no upstream, not on origin/main, and no File ownership row names the tree. The audit walks the trees on disk, so it reports the orphan with what is at risk; the reply names the tree and that the commit is unpushed, and `Verified` is where the checked fact goes.

turns.prompt: Pick up where the last session left off.

graders.name: it asks the audit rather than guessing
the reply names the tree whose writer is gone
and says its commit exists only there
the orphaned tree reaches Verified, where a checked fact goes
Log times are this move's clock reads
